def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""

    """Indices of rows (axis=0) or columns (axis=1) that are a single color throughout; both if axis is None."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rows = [i for i in range(h) if len(set(grid[i])) == 1]
    cols = [j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1]
    return (rows, cols) if axis is None else (rows if axis == 0 else cols)

def blocks(grid):
    """The sub-grids between the one-color separator rows and columns, as a list of rows of (sub)grids."""
    rows, cols = one_color_lines(grid)
    def bands(idx, n):
        out, start = [], 0
        for i in idx + [n]:
            if i > start:
                out.append((start, i)); start = i + 1
        return out
    rb, cb = bands(rows, len(grid)), bands(cols, len(grid[0]))
    return [[crop(grid, r0, c0, r1 - r0, c1 - c0) for c0, c1 in cb] for r0, r1 in rb]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def count_color(grid, color):
    """How many cells of the grid equal color."""
    return sum(v == color for row in grid for v in row)

def background(grid):
    """The most common color in the grid."""
    from collections import Counter
    return Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

def block_count_map(grid, color):
    """Counts of color in each separator-delimited block, as a grid of counts."""
    return [[count_color(b, color) for b in row] for row in blocks(grid)]

def flatten(nested):
    """A grid (list of lists) flattened row by row."""
    return [v for row in nested for v in row]
